definition: one read off the panel, and the two mappings I can name off the rows

settled:
Concretely: I glance at the panel. Faith is green, Health is yellow, the others sit where they sit.

The yellow is the cue. Health has not had enough today.

I did not have to remember that. The light remembered it for me, and it hands me a little motivation to go and do something about it.

Off the rows I can name three. Abby carries Faith. Amy carries Health, as the layer that keeps my day flowing. Ali carries Learn.

title: The Glance That Tells Me What Is Short
